units.source_text: 阿清虽然这么想，却像盼望节日的马戏团的姑娘那样，显得生气勃勃的样子。

en.t: Although A Qing thought this way, she looked full of life, like a circus girl eagerly awaiting a festival.

units.source_text: 另一方面，她又习惯性地幻想着自己的葬礼——她曾抚爱过的孩子，在灵柩后面排成长长的队列，登上山上的墓地。

en.t: At the same time, she habitually imagined her own funeral: the children she had once cared for forming a long line behind her coffin and climbing up to the graveyard on the mountain.
